title: Zesty British Brown Rice Noodle Sandwich
description: A bright, plantbased brunch sandwich that marries toasted sourdough with fluffy brownrice noodles tossed in a lemonhabanero vinaigrette, finished with fresh herbs.
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 °C and lightly brush one side of each slice of sourdough with olive oil, then toast in the oven until golden, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, bring 2 L of salted water to a boil and cook the brown rice noodles for 3–4 minutes, until just al dente; drain and rinse under cold water.
In a small bowl whisk together lemon zest, lemon juice, minced habanero, dijon mustard, tahini, sea salt, 1 tbsp olive oil and a splash of water to thin; adjust seasoning to taste.
Fold the drained noodles into the vinaigrette until well coated; set aside to chill slightly.
Spread a generous layer of the noodle mix over the toasted side of four slices of bread, then top each with sliced avocado and a sprinkle of chopped parsley.
Close the sandwich with the remaining bread slices, toasted side down; cut each into two triangles.
Serve immediately, paired with a light cucumber salad or a cup of herbal tea for a refreshing brunch.
Optional: drizzle a little extra olive oil over the sandwich for added sheen.
